air.note: Latest nearby measured PM2.5 only. It is not a future AQI forecast, an exposure estimate at this place, or a check of other pollutants.

uncertainty: Particles and gases use CAMS Global hourly output with unknown model-run age. Margin tests are user-chosen sensitivity scenarios, not error bounds, ensemble spread or calibrated confidence. A fit means weather preferences and any requested pollutant or smoke checks are met in the available products. These checks are not a full air-quality assessment. Smoke checks apply only to hourly samples bracketing the window, not continuous concentrations, total PM2.5 or health-safe conditions. Alert coverage remains separate.
